subject: [PATCH v2 1/2] arm64: sdei: Run the event handler on the kernel vectors

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Raised a question about whether it's necessary to switch to raw_cpu_read() for stable trees, considering the new splat introduced by this patch.
reviews.raw_body:
On Thu, Nov 05, 2026 at 06:37:46PM +0000, Catalin Marinas wrote:
> Worth a separate patch to fix SDEI handling with pseudo-NMI on and no
> changes to __this_cpu_read() above needed. So, for this patch:
> 
> Reviewed-by: Catalin Marinas <catalin.marinas@arm.com>

Thanks!

Would it still make sense to switch to raw_cpu_read() in this patch for
stable@? The splat is new with this patch, so without it stable trees
would also need the PMR fix.

Let me know if you want a re-spin with raw_cpu_read().

-- 
  Kiryl Shutsemau / Kirill A. Shutemov

reviews.author: Catalin Marinas
reviews.summary: Responded that there's no need to re-spin the patch, and offered to fix it locally.
